description_en: Queries the details of a specified load balancing instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeLoadBalancerAttribute查询指定负载均衡实例的详细信息
name: DescribeLoadBalancerAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

Address.description_en: The service address of the load balancing instance
Address.description_zh: 负载均衡实例服务地址

AddressIPVersion.description_en: The IP version of the load balancing instance. Valid values: ipv4 or ipv6
AddressIPVersion.description_zh: 负载均衡实例的IP版本。取值：ipv4或者ipv6

AddressType.description_en: The address type of the load balancing instance
AddressType.description_zh: 负载均衡实例的地址类型

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the backend server

Port.description_en: The port used by the backend server
Port.description_zh: 后端服务器使用的端口

ServerId.description_en: The instance ID of the backend server

Type.description_en: The server type of the backend server

Weight.description_en: The weight of the backend server

Bandwidth.description_en: The peak bandwidth of the load balancing instance. The default value is -1, which indicates that bandwidth is not throttled
Bandwidth.description_zh: 负载均衡带宽峰值，默认值为-1（表示不限速）

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the load balancing instance (UTC)
CreateTime.description_zh: 负载均衡实例的创建时间（UTC）

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the load balancing instance in ISO 8601 UTC format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
EndTime.description_zh: 负载均衡实例结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 时间格式，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

ListenerPorts.description_en: The frontend ports used by the load balancing instance
ListenerPorts.description_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口

items.description_en: The frontend ports used by the load balancing instance
items.description_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口

ListenerPortsAndProtocols.description_en: The frontend ports and protocols used by the load balancing instance
ListenerPortsAndProtocols.description_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口和协议

items.description_en: The frontend ports and protocols used by the load balancing instance
items.description_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口和协议

BackendServerPort.description_en: The backend port used by the load balancing instance. Valid values: 1 to 65535
BackendServerPort.description_zh: 负载均衡实例后端使用的端口，取值：1~65535

ForwardPort.description_en: The destination listener port to which traffic is forwarded
ForwardPort.description_zh: 转发到的目的监听端口

ListenerForward.description_en: Indicates whether listener forwarding is enabled

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the load balancing instance

LoadBalancerName.description_en: The name of the load balancing instance

LoadBalancerSpec.description_en: The specification of the load balancing instance

LoadBalancerStatus.description_en:
The listener status of the load balancing instance. Valid values:
Active: The listeners of the instance can forward received traffic based on rules.
InActive: The listeners of the instance no longer forward received traffic
LoadBalancerStatus.description_zh:
负载均衡实例监听状态。取值：
Active：实例中的监听可以根据规则转发接收的流量。
InActive：实例中的监听不会再转发接收的流量

LoadBalancerType.description_en: The type of the load balancing instance

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid (currently the only supported billing method): pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型。取值：
PrePaid：预付费。
PostPaid（目前仅支持该付费类型）：后付费
